// Command control is the clean control's plugin with one word of a message changed since its 0.0.1 was released:
// the plants that read RELEASES build 0.0.1's plugin.wasm from the clean control's source, and
// this source builds other bytes. A plugin of a made-up tool that provides entries alone, on the SDK's Serve, so
// every contract case the pinned gragas runs is answered as a plugin answers it.
// Its entries are always none, for a tool version in plugin.yaml's tool_versions (">=10.13.0 <11.0.0"); a
// version outside it answers unsupported (check C16), and the other operations answer unsupported.
package main

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/birdtable/gragas-plugin-sdk/plugin"
	"github.com/birdtable/gragas-plugin-sdk/wire"
)

// control provides entries and nothing else.
type control struct{ plugin.Unsupported }

// Entries is no entry, whatever the tool printed, for a tool version the plugin serves.
func (control) Entries(r wire.EntriesRequest) (wire.EntriesResponse, error) {
	if !served(r.ToolVersion) {
		return wire.EntriesResponse{}, plugin.Unsupportedf("this plugin serves the fixture >=10.13.0 <11.0.0, and the request is for %q", r.ToolVersion)
	}
	return wire.EntriesResponse{}, nil
}

// served is whether v, major.minor.patch, is in >=10.13.0 <11.0.0: major 10 and minor 13 or more.
func served(v string) bool {
	parts := strings.Split(v, ".")
	if len(parts) != 3 {
		return false
	}
	var n [3]int
	for i, p := range parts {
		x, err := strconv.Atoi(p)
		if err != nil || x < 0 || strconv.Itoa(x) != p {
			return false
		}
		n[i] = x
	}
	return n[0] == 10 && n[1] >= 13
}

func main() { plugin.Serve(control{}) }
